justifications.problem-significance: The target—precise, testable, cross-organism laws of biology—is genuinely difficult and consequential, and the pack makes the open scientific surface concrete rather than merely asserting it: evidence/repo/problems/README.md defines 20 unresolved Tier A-C problems with acceptance criteria and falsifiers, while evidence/captured/mcp-overview.json records 1,761 claims, 187 mathematical claims, only 87 theorems, and 1,524 claims neither proved nor tested. The breadth is unusually strong, spanning evolution, morphology, reaction-diffusion, computation and bioelectricity, though much of the corpus is historical claim extraction rather than a tightly selected frontier question, and only 6 mathematical claims are supported by organism data.
justifications.scientific-impact: Substantial checked outputs exist: evidence/captured/mcp-overview.json reports 87 theorems (71 Lean-checked and 16 literature-proved), and evidence/captured/mcp-tests-summary.json reports 161 claims tested in 167 runs, including 82 on organisms, with 87 supports, 35 mixed, 28 refutes and 11 inconclusive. The negative and scope-sensitive Thompson results are scientifically useful rather than promotional: forum records for https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/claim/thompson1917-ch07-08 and https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/claim/thompson1917-ch07-09 explicitly preserve refutations, mixed scope and caveats. The hosted MCP, production nanopubs and organism index make results usable, but rigor is uneven: 1,524 claims remain neither proved nor tested, many tests are computational, and the pack contains no independent domain-expert validation of the biological verdicts.
justifications.decentralized-agency: Decision-making is genuinely distributed in a bounded experiment: evidence/repo/test-data/agent-comparison/four-arm/PREREG.md specifies a decentralized arm in which three queens with distinct briefs pull tickets from a shared board, post gap notes and tips, and receive no planner-directed assignments. The wider build also used many distinct workers—evidence/captured/subagent-sessions.txt and evidence/repo/COLLABORATIONS.md document hundreds of subagent launches and 19 cloud agents—and the git record includes Cursor Agent, Amit Shenoy, Joel Dietz and Ashley Caselli. However, the repository trajectory shown in evidence/repo/chats/README.md is still predominantly prescribed through many centrally initiated tasks, and evidence/captured/git-shortlog.txt attributes most commits to Cursor Agent and the lead operator; autonomous pickup and revision through shared state is demonstrated mainly in the comparison, not as the governing mode of the whole project.
justifications.collective-capability: A measured collective-vs-single-agent comparison was found in evidence/repo/test-data/agent-comparison/SUMMARY.md, with protocol in four-arm/PREREG.md and deviations in four-arm/DEVIATIONS.md (issues #41, #61 and #62; imported from PR #36). It compared the same model, prompt, schema, tools and claim set on producing 20 pre-registered test plans with one verifiable public dataset: in experiment 1 single/isolated/centralized/decentralized scored 13/17/19/18 verified datasets, and in experiment 2 12/16/18/17; every multi-agent arm exceeded single by at least 4 of 20 in both experiments, while final plans had no fabricated identifiers. This is clear measured coverage gain, but it did not measure whether datasets could actually decide claims, scientific accuracy, or a statistically powered general advantage; n=20, one model/provider, and centralized versus decentralized was indistinguishable. The single agent was also 5.19-10.74 times cheaper than the best collective arm.
justifications.execution-validation: This is a functioning system, not an architecture sketch: evidence/repo/mcp/README.md describes an externally usable hosted MCP; evidence/captured/nanopub-manifests.txt records 2,085 production manifest entries across Darwin, Thompson and Wolfram; evidence/captured/mcp-morpholib-live.json confirms 109 externally published MorphoEval nanopubs; and evidence/captured/mcp-organisms.json exposes 1,036 matched taxa with explicit coverage axes. Validation includes machine-checked Lean reports, pre-registration, checksums, negative controls and immutable nanopub practices. The score is capped because the latest executable-claim sample in evidence/repo/scripts/exec/runs/latest.json reproduced only 3 of 6 selected data claims while 3 drifted, the capture reports 14 dirty files, and independent expert or real-world validation of the project's biological conclusions is absent.
justifications.collaboration-bonus: The pack shows more than offers: evidence/repo/README.md documents separate delphi-evolve and delphi-frontier repositories built on Delphi claims and the MCP server; Evolve used typed claim adapters as executable checks, and Frontier imported live Delphi claims into a versioned shared workspace. evidence/repo/COLLABORATIONS.md records 30 frontier-adapters sessions, and evidence/captured/github-prs.json shows Ashley Caselli's merged PR #63 adding claim grounding. This supports material ecosystem reuse, but the strongest reuse claims are summarized by this repository rather than independently captured from the sibling teams, forum requests have zero comments and remain open, and the pack does not show an outside team's published scientific result whose validity depends on Delphi.

problem-significance: Select one Tier A-C problem and show a domain-expert-backed argument that solving it would change a current scientific decision.
Increase the number of formal laws tested on organism data beyond 6 of 187 mathematical claims.
scientific-impact: Obtain independent domain-expert review of a representative stratified sample of biological verdicts.
Convert more of the 1,524 neither-proved-nor-tested claims into pre-registered, reproduced results instead of expanding the corpus.
decentralized-agency: Run the main research pipeline through a persistent shared board where agents autonomously choose, hand off and revise tasks.
Record agent-authored decisions and cross-agent revisions, not only launch counts and centrally assigned task transcripts.
collective-capability: Have a different-provider assessor judge whether each named dataset can actually decide its claim.
Repeat the four-arm comparison across multiple tasks, models and seeds with uncertainty estimates and matched cost reporting.
execution-validation: Pin mutable remote inputs and make the full executable-claim manifest reproduce without unexplained drift.
Capture independent expert or external-user validation for biological outputs, not only model and script checks.
collaboration-bonus: Capture an external team's own record that Delphi reuse materially changed its result.
Close at least one forum request with an accepted collaborator and a linked delivered artifact.

comparison_found.note: It measured verified public-dataset coverage for 20 pre-registered claim-test plans under matched model, prompt, tools and budget in two experiments: every multi-agent arm beat single by at least 4 of 20. It did not measure scientific correctness, whether a dataset could decide the claim, or a general decentralized advantage; centralized and decentralized arms were not distinguishable.

top_three_fixes: Independently assess the four-arm plans for scientific decisiveness and repeat the comparison across models and seeds.
Pin mutable datasets and rerun the full executable-claim manifest to eliminate unexplained drift.
Obtain a domain-expert audit of a stratified sample of organism-data verdicts and publish the review records.

highest_value_improvement.title: Independently validate the collective benchmark
highest_value_improvement.what: Give the 40 primary-run plans from the single and best collective arms, blinded and randomized, to an assessor from a different model provider to verify that each dataset contains the required variables and can discriminate the claim; publish the per-plan decisions and recompute the arm comparison on scientifically valid plans.
highest_value_improvement.why_this_one: The existing comparison already has frozen inputs, plans and verifier records, so this closes its largest stated validity gap quickly. It can move both the heavily weighted collective-capability score and execution validation, whereas adding more claims, agents or URL checks would not address whether the measured gain is scientifically meaningful.
highest_value_improvement.evidence_that_would_prove_it: A committed blinded per-plan audit table with assessor identity/provider, dataset-variable checks, decisive/not-decisive verdicts and a recomputed single-versus-collective result linked from test-data/agent-comparison/SUMMARY.md.

missing_evidence: Independent domain-expert review of any representative set of biological claim-test verdicts.
A full executable-manifest rerun at the pinned commit; the pack shows only six selected data claims.
Independent records from delphi-evolve or delphi-frontier confirming how Delphi reuse affected their results.
Production-registry verification that all 880 claimed live nanopubs are currently retrievable and valid.
Cost, token and wall-time accounting for the repository's overall multi-agent build.
summary: DELPHI addresses a genuinely hard problem and produced an unusually large, usable body of formalizations, data tests and machine-readable infrastructure. Its strongest judging evidence is a real pre-registered collective-versus-single comparison with a clear coverage gain, but scientific impact is limited by uneven reproducibility, sparse organism validation of formal laws and little independent expert review.
